meta_description:
2M likes, 7,342 comments - thefitnesschef_ on September 17, 2025: "Would you try this bizarre cheesy potato ‘thing’? Here’s how mine turned out 🥔 
-

I slightly modified mine to include mozzarella and chorizo. Additionally, instead of deep frying I used my air fryer.
-

Ingredients (makes 2):
600g peeled potatoes
2tbsp melted butter 
5tbsp flour
60g mozzarella 
30g chorizo
5ml olive oil
-

Method:
1. Peel and boil potatoes until soft, then drain and mash
2. Add the butter and flour and mix with a fork, and then your hands until smooth, then form a large ball with your hands 
3. Lay out a sheet of cling film, then drizzle the olive oil over it
4. Add the potato ball to the cling film and press to make a large circle
5. Add the mozzarella and chorizo to the centre of the circle
6. Use the cling film to roll up the potatoe on all 4 sides, pressing down and sealing any gaps
7. Air fryer at 240 degrees for 7-8 minutes each side, using a spatula to turn halfway
8. Once cooked, eating with a knife and fork is advised 🤣
-

Nutrition information per single serving:
-

Calories: 480
Protein: 20g
Carbs: 64g
Fat: 16g
-
Original recipe: @foodiefrontier0 
-

#recipeoftheday #potato #nutritionist".
